desc:
👗 2 Player Dress-Up Challenge! 💃

Grab your partner and dress up a mannequin before the timer runs out!
👯 Work together to find clothes 🧥
🎨 Pick the best style and color combos
🌟 Vote on everyone’s mannequin at the end (0-5 stars!)
💥 Fun, fast, and chaotic — who has the best style?

💅 Fashion + teamwork = 🔥
💬 Like the game? Let us know what theme YOU wanna see next!

👍 Like + favorite if you're drippy
👥 Join the group for updates + new themes weekly!
